description: Page through one named list from the analysis, e.g. symbols, imports, exports, sections, libraries, types, methods, pinvokes, selectors, instructions, tables, columns, requests, endpoints, permissions, components, modules, edges, ipcChannels, findings. Use hexvero_analyze to see which exist.

maxBytes.description: Hard upper bound for the serialized page in bytes (default 262144). A page reports next, bytes and, for an item cut to fit, itemTruncated + itemBytes

text.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on each item

name: hexvero_collection
title: Page a collection
